articles.summary: New York – February 24, 2026 – Equitable, a leading financial services organization and principal franchise of Equitable Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: EQH), today published a new study, “PEAK 35TM: Guiding a New Generation of Wealth,” exploring how millennials are both building and inheriting wealth. The white paper equips financial advisors with key insights to better serve this generation, as millennials reshape expectations for growing, protecting and stewarding wealth.
articles.title: Equitable PEAK 35™ study: Millennials seek trusted financial advice as they build and inherit wealth
